title: Nonpreemptive Scheduling While Learning Context-Dependent Service Rates
abstract: arXiv:2609.37660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study nonpreemptive contextual queueing bandits in a single-server system. Each job is represented by a $d$-dimensional context vector; in each round, a job may arrive with its context drawn from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{D}$, and its departure probability is determined by a logistic model of that context vector with an unknown parameter $\theta^*$. The server learns from service outcomes while deciding which waiting job to serve and whether to idle, aiming to minimize queue-length regret, the gap between its expected terminal queue length and the minimum achievable by an admissible policy. Once selected, a job must be served until completion, and we refer to this as the nonpreemptive setting. A central challenge is that, even with full model knowledge, the optimal policy cannot in general be characterized by a simple myopic rule, since the optimal action can change with the remaining horizon at the same queue state. translated_title: 学习上下文相关服务速率的非抢占式调度
translated_abstract: 我们研究单服务器系统中的非抢占式上下文排队老虎机问题。每个作业由一个 d 维上下文向量表示；在每一轮中，可能有作业到达，其上下文从未知分布 $\mathcal{D}$ 中抽取，其离开概率由该上下文向量在含未知参数 $\theta^*$ 的逻辑斯蒂模型下决定。服务器在决定服务哪个等待作业以及是否空闲的同时，从服务结果中不断学习，目标是最小化队列长度遗憾——即其期望终端队列长度与可容许策略所能达到的最小值之间的差距。一旦某作业被选中，就必须被服务直至完成，我们将其称为非抢占式设定。一个核心挑战在于：即使完全掌握模型信息，最优策略通常也无法用简单的短视规则来刻画，因为在相同的队列状态下，最优动作会随剩余时域的变化而改变。
tldr: 该论文研究了单服务器系统中边学习未知上下文相关服务速率、边进行非抢占式调度决策的排队老虎机问题，并揭示了即使模型完全已知，最优策略也无法用简单的短视规则刻画这一核心挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper studies nonpreemptive contextual queueing bandits in a single-server system, where the server schedules jobs while learning context-dependent service rates, and reveals the key challenge that even with full model knowledge, the optimal policy cannot be characterized by a simple myopic rule.
